response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer (15+ years) with strong software craftsmanship, testing, and some low-latency backend work, but the role requires SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architecture, hardware-software co-design, and deep-learning workload optimization — none of which appear in the resume. Education is a BS in Computer Science (meets the 8+ years experience path formally), yet there is no evidence of computer architecture, GPU/SIMD/MIMD, RTL/simulation modeling, or DNN training/inference optimization. The gap between the candidate's web/cloud application background and this principal-level hardware architecture role is too large to bridge in a screen.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering across many domains
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work (D, async I/O, fibers)
Some C/C++ and embedded/hardware-adjacent exposure (National Instruments, robotics)
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload or GPU/accelerator optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not principal-level silicon performance

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design
No AI accelerator / DNN performance expertise
Long, senior software engineering track record
